§ One Key Message

Refreshing — “Segar”

Whatever the flavour — sell the feeling. Cold, fruity and always refreshing. A chilled bottle does half the selling for you, so keep stock cold and lead every taste with Orange.

Apa pun perisanya — jual perasaannya. Sejuk, berbuah dan sentiasa segar.
